purpose: Accept one or more playlist/page targets and emit deterministic machine-readable link and ordered-membership artifacts without coupling the reusable core to one consumer repository.
core_owns: stable source identity and target provenance
ordered occurrence versus unique entity separation
CSV projections derived from canonical JSON
adapters_own: provider-specific throttling, selectors, and failure translation
forbidden_core_assumptions: YouTube-only identifiers in generic core schemas unless namespaced as adapter data
canonical_artifacts: runtime browser/session state is never source
next_transition: Integrate the existing playlist-link-extractor prototype under this boundary and prove the core/adapter seam before widening compatibility claims.
